whatsNewEn: Version 6.0.36! 1) Enhanced device pairing with interactive role setup guide (Master, Admin, Observer). 2) Fixed Training section – full synchronization and persistent logging of workout sessions. 3) Redesigned Nutrition view (GlikoSense Nutri) with stability indicators and 1-Click Add to Plate. 4) General bug fixes and performance improvements.
